# Pixel Crunch

Pixel Crunch is a free, open-source image toolkit that processes user images locally in the browser. Cloudflare Pages serves the static application and public model files; Pixel Crunch does not provide a remote image-processing or inference API.

## Spanish pages

- Home and product documentation: https://pixel-crunch.josuem01.dev/
- Compress images: https://pixel-crunch.josuem01.dev/comprimir/
- Convert images: https://pixel-crunch.josuem01.dev/convertir/
- Remove image backgrounds: https://pixel-crunch.josuem01.dev/quitar-fondo/

## English pages

- Home and product documentation: https://pixel-crunch.josuem01.dev/en/
- Image compressor: https://pixel-crunch.josuem01.dev/en/compress/
- Image converter: https://pixel-crunch.josuem01.dev/en/convert/
- Background remover: https://pixel-crunch.josuem01.dev/en/remove-background/

## Product facts

- Compression supports JPG, JPEG, JFIF, PNG, WebP, GIF, and SVG.
- Conversion accepts browser-decodable JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, and AVIF files and exports JPG, PNG, WebP, or AVIF when the browser supports the codec.
- Background removal downloads a public model on demand and runs inference on the user's device.
- Selected images are held in browser memory during the session and are not uploaded to a Pixel Crunch processing service.
- First-visit or complete offline operation is not guaranteed.
- Source code: https://github.com/JosueMM01/pixel-crunch
- License: AGPL-3.0-only

For the canonical, localized description of a feature, use the corresponding page above.
